cohort: 120 pregnant women who underwent labor induction at Muhimbili National Hospital in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, between January 2021 and July 2021
finding: Labor induction at Muhimbili National Hospital was associated with favorable maternal and neonatal outcomes, including low rates of maternal complications and positive neonatal Apgar scores.
mod_finding: The majority of induced women (61.7%) delivered vaginally, while 38.3% underwent cesarean section.
